newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Tedco plans Z$53 million issue.
newsitem.headline: Tedco plans Z$53 million issue.

text.p: Zimbabwean clothing and furniture retailer Tedco said on Wednesday it planned to raise Z$53 million through a rights offer of 22.8 million shares at an issue price of Z$2.35 each.

The offer was on the basis of one new share for every 10 shares held and the company said in a statement the money raised would be used to strengthen its capital base and to develop supporting business systems for its growing retail operation.
The offer opens on April 21 and closes on May 7.
